description: Search financial news from finlight, which tags every article with the companies, countries and categories it is about and the sentiment it carries. Find articles by words, stock ticker, source, country or category, get only the articles added since the last run, read an article from its link, and measure how positive or negative the news about a company is. Needs a finlight API key; the free plan sees news 12 hours late.
